title: chat-v1 compatibility polisher: function handoff & structured response parity
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: polish remaining edge-cases in our /v1/chat.completions compatibility shim so customers using OpenAI-style params see consistent behavior when using streaming, functions, and structured outputs. This PR focuses on three practical gaps discovered during a PLG customer migration: role aliasing when clients send nonstandard role labels, stop-array coalescing with mixed encodings (bytes vs strings), and a graceful logprob fallback when models do not provide exhaustive token logprobs during framed streaming.

What this change does: normalizes alias roles (system/meta -> system, usr/user -> user), coalesces stop sequences at both the adapter and runtime stream boundary to avoid double-truncation, and introduces a logprob-fallback path that synthesizes stable per-token probability hints (not full logprobs) when upstream models return partial data. Additionally this PR refines the function-call handshake in the stream envelope: we now emit a preflight "fncap" delta to indicate function schema acceptance before tool payloads arrive, and when a function is invoked we ensure the framed JSON body uses the same structured-shape negotiated by the v1 adapter.

Compatibility notes: preserves existing Redwood streaming framing for native clients; changes are gated behind the chatv1 compatibility flag and a runtime toggle so we can roll back quickly if there are regressions. Unit and integration tests added; a small e2e with the Python SDK demonstrates parity with OpenAI's behavior for the customers' test prompt set.

Checklist:
- [x] role alias normalization
- [x] stop array coalescing at adapter+runtime
- [x] logprob fallback path with safety heuristics
- [x] function-call preflight delta (fncap) + shaped payloads
- [x] integration tests + sample SDK snippet in docs
- [x] feature toggle and metric emitted (chatv1.compat.polish.enabled)

Related: ENG-3241 (param parity backlog), ENG-3309 (streaming flakiness triage).

release_notes:
- ChatV1 compatibility: normalize role aliases and reduce client-side mismatch errors.
- Stream stability: coalesce stop arrays across adapter/runtime to prevent premature truncation.
- Function calling: introduce fncap preflight delta and enforce structured function payloads for v1 clients.
- Logprobs: synthetic fallback path to avoid noisier null/omitted logprobs during streaming.
(Flagged behind chatv1.compat.polish toggle; no user-visible breaking changes expected)
